old_string: Driving = Registry.Active[player] ~= nil, TutorialDone = p.TutorialDone == true,
new_string: Driving = Registry.Active[player] ~= nil, TutorialDone = p.TutorialDone == true, Tutorial = type(p.Tutorial) == "table" and p.Tutorial or nil,

old_string:
p.Reserved = o
	p.Offers[slot] = nil
	publishBay(player, d)
	return {ok = true, msg = "Reserved " .. C.Parts[o.Part].Name .. "!"}
new_string:
p.Reserved = o
	p.Offers[slot] = nil
	player:SetAttribute("PlowReserved", true)
	publishBay(player, d)
	return {ok = true, msg = "Reserved " .. C.Parts[o.Part].Name .. "!"}

old_string: function actions.TutorialDone(player, d, p) p.TutorialDone = true; player:SetAttribute("PlowTutorialDone", true); return {ok = true} end
